title: conditional-init-job-and-hook-templating-to-support-idempotent-private-upgrades
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem / motivation: private deployments running older charts sometimes fail upgrades when init/rollback jobs are unguarded or when cluster topology (multi-az vs single-az) requires different init behavior. This caused a recent support case (SUP-122) where the init job re-ran on every helm upgrade and blocked subsequent hooks. Goals: 1) make init/rollback jobs idempotent and conditional based on values and cluster facts, 2) provide a clear values migration path for private customers upgrading from older installers, 3) keep helm hooks robust for both air-gapped on-prem installs and VPC installs, 4) add minimal integration tests to prevent regressions. What this PR changes: - values.schema.json: introduce new top-level keys private.init.runOnce (boolean), private.init.leaderElectionConfig (string), private.upgrade.mode ("canary"|"standard"), and private.hooks.enableRollback (boolean). The schema contains descriptions and default values to be surfaced in the installer UI. - templates/init-job.yaml: converts the previous unconditional Job -> a helm template that renders the Job only when .Values.private.enabled and .Values.private.init.runOnce are true OR when clusterTopology == "multi-az" (we detect via .Capabilities but allow manual override). The Job implements a lightweight idempotency check against a ConfigMap (key: redwood-private-init-leader) so only one node performs expensive migrations; the Job re-checks to avoid duplicate work on retries. - templates/hooks/preflight-crd-check.yaml: pre-install hook that verifies required CRDs exist (CRDs vary for on-prem). When CRDs are missing the hook fails fast with actionable message. - templates/hooks/rollback-job.yaml: rollback job is now gated by .Values.private.hooks.enableRollback and annotated with helm.sh/hook-weight to run before any other teardown hooks. It attempts a safe rollback probe and records results into a Kubernetes JobResult ConfigMap for operator inspection. - templates/_helpers.tpl: add sprig helpers and template snippets to centralize conditional logic (clusterTopologyOrOverride, shouldRenderInitJob). - values.yaml: sensible defaults that preserve current behavior for existing private installs (backwards-compatible defaults: runOnce: false, enableRollback: true). - docs/UPGRADE_PRIVATE.md: migration steps describing how to opt-in to runOnce, how leaderElectionConfig works, and how to set clusterTopology when Helm cannot auto-detect. - tests/upgrade-integration.sh: small CI smoke test run in kind to validate that repeated helm upgrade with runOnce=true does not re-run init work and that rollback hook executes when enabled. Notes on testing and CI: added a new pipeline job (helm-private-upgrade-smoke) to the chart CI that exercises the new template conditionals in a minimal kind cluster; this job is non-blocking but runs on merge to main. Backwards compatibility: default values keep previous behavior unless operators explicitly opt-in to runOnce or change topology. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship as patch release with clear release notes and migration guide. Checklist: - [x] schema and values documented - [x] idempotent init job implemented - [x] rollback gate and weight added - [x] tests and CI smoke job added - [x] reviewers addressed comments

review_comments: Omar Salazar: Flagged the leader-election ConfigMap name collision risk if multiple clusters share the same namespace; requested we namespace the ConfigMap with .Release.Name — addressed in second commit.
Priya Natarajan: Asked for clearer failure messages from preflight CRD hook so operators know remediation steps; updated hook to include CRD table and suggested kubectl commands.
Benito Alvarez: Requested we keep default behavior unchanged for existing installs — verified values.yaml keeps runOnce=false by default and added UPGRADE_PRIVATE.md migration notes.

Maya Chen: Reply to Omar and Priya explaining idempotency approach (ConfigMap-based leader lock plus job-level re-check), and noting we intentionally avoid leader-election libs to keep image small; added comment in template.
Omar Salazar: Approval after ConfigMap name change and small nit on template indentation fixed.
Priya Natarajan: Approved; suggested follow-up to add metric for init-job duration (tracked ENG-7628).
release_notes: Add conditional, idempotent init job and gated rollback hook for redwood-private helm chart. New values: private.init.runOnce, private.init.leaderElectionConfig, private.upgrade.mode, private.hooks.enableRollback. Includes migration guide and CI smoke test to prevent regressions.
